method: whole-tower coherence gamma2 = |sum(z)|^2/(N*sum(|z|^2)) over the masked mast echo (bright cluster: intensity >= peak_frac*peak AND >= median_mult*strip median). Single scatterer -> no segment split. One row per distinct overpass; pseudo-replicate burst rows (same overpass under several burst ids a few seconds apart / per polarisation) are collapsed first.
